The bug stems from the SslConfiguration plugin factory method: the legacy 3-parameter createSSLConfiguration overload was used instead of the 4-parameter version introduced in Log4j 2.12.0, causing the verifyHostName configuration attribute to be silently dropped during SSL configuration creation (GitHub PR #4075).
